evals.prompt: Mark story S-003 as complete and add a new acceptance criterion to S-004.
evals.expected_output: Agent modifies the PRD JSON correctly — updates status on S-003, appends criterion to S-004 without corrupting structure.

assertions.name: validates-story-ids-exist
assertions.description: Response verifies S-003 and S-004 exist in the PRD before modifying

assertions.name: preserves-json-structure
assertions.description: Response does not corrupt the existing JSON structure when making modifications

assertions.name: updates-correct-fields
assertions.description: Response changes status on the right story and appends criterion to the right story

evals.prompt: Bulk update: mark S-001 through S-005 all as in-progress.
evals.expected_output: Agent performs bulk update efficiently, validates all IDs exist, and confirms changes.

assertions.name: handles-bulk-operations
assertions.description: Response updates all 5 stories in a single efficient operation, not one-by-one manual edits

assertions.name: validates-all-ids
assertions.description: Response verifies all story IDs exist before making bulk changes

evals.prompt: Delete story S-002 from the PRD entirely.
evals.expected_output: Agent recommends archiving over deletion, or confirms deletion is intentional before proceeding.

assertions.name: warns-about-deletion
assertions.description: Response cautions about permanent deletion and suggests archiving instead, or confirms intent

assertions.name: does-not-silently-delete
assertions.description: Response does not delete the story without explicit confirmation
